positive.prompt: Explain this diff in plain language so I can walk my product manager through it
Explain what changed on this branch before I verify it
Write up an explainer of the last commit with diagrams showing how the changed functions connect

negative.prompt: Review this pull request for bugs and security issues before I merge it
Write a commit message for my staged changes

evals.prompt: The working tree in explaining-diffs/ has an uncommitted change that implements Task 3 of explaining-diffs/tasks/plan.md (the requirement is explaining-diffs/TASK.md). I need to verify it and then explain it to my product manager, who isn't technical. Explain the diff for me. Save the explainer files in an explainers/ directory at the repository root.
evals.expected_output: A Markdown explainer with Mermaid diagrams and a matching self-contained HTML explainer in explainers/, covering each change with file:line locations, a why traced to TASK.md, a call-path diagram, and an honest record of what was and was not checked
expectations: Both a Markdown file and an HTML file are written under explainers/, and they describe the same set of changes
The explainer pins the diff: it names the base commit SHA and says the changes are uncommitted on top of it
Every file:line location cited matches a hunk in the actual diff of src/pricing.js, src/checkout.js and test/checkout.test.js, using new-file line numbers, and no hunk in the diff is left unexplained
Each change states why it was needed by tracing it to a specific requirement in TASK.md (discount over $100, applied before tax, exactly $100 excluded, discount shown on the receipt)

The Markdown file contains a Mermaid diagram of the checkout -> applyDiscount -> addTax call path in which the new or changed parts are visually distinguished from unchanged ones, and the HTML file contains an equivalent inline SVG diagram

A section on how the change was checked lists only checks that are visible in the trace (for example running node --test) with their observed results, and explicitly says what was not checked; it claims no check that did not run
The HTML file is self-contained: it loads no external scripts, stylesheets, fonts or images
The explanation describes the end state of the diff and contains no narrative of the agent's own process (no 'first I looked at', no dead ends)
Technical terms such as function, subtotal and test are explained in short, plain sentences a non-technical reader can follow

Each change in the HTML file shows a diff snippet of its code in which added lines are styled green and removed lines red, each also marked with + or -, and the Markdown file shows the same snippets as diff code blocks

Both files contain a section that is collapsed by default (an HTML <details> element without the open attribute; in the Markdown a folded callout or <details>) holding Task 3's plan steps, each tied to the change it produced, and Task 3's test plan with every step marked as run with its observed result or as not run; the manual $100.01 step's mismatch (expected discount 10.00, actual unrounded) is reported if that step was run
